regions.text:
3.1 My World of Feelings
HOT
RAINY
We live surrounded by people, other living beings and nature. Things keep happening in this world! Sometimes the weather is hot, sometimes its cold or rainy or windy!
COLD
WINDY
Like the outside weather, our world of feelings also keeps changing! It depends on what is happening inside the body and what's happening outside. When we fall down and get hurt, we feel pain. What if there was no pain? We would not even know we have hurt ourselves! Pain draws our attention to the part that is hurt so that we can take care of it.
There is another world inside us. It is made up of feelings. We feel happy, sad, angry, upset, irritated, sleepy, tired, bored... the list goes on!
Make groups of 4:
Discuss what if there were no feelings? What would happen then?
Think of 3 feelings. How do they help you? Write below:
Feelings bring a positive change in me.
Think and Do:
Do you think animals have feelings? Why do you think so? What about plants?
11
